name: lectern
description: Self-hosted app for finding and getting audiobooks and ebooks.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lectern/shared && npm run build -w @lectern/server && npm run build -w @lectern/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lectern/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lectern/server && npm run typecheck -w @lectern/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lectern/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @lectern/server" "npm run dev -w @lectern/web"
